changelog: - **Two Gates that draw on one Pool and feed one Converter now share that Pool, and the Converter runs at one rate.** When a Converter is fed by Gates, the engine works out one plan for all of them before anything moves. That plan looked at the first Gate only. Two Gates each asking 50 from a Pool of 60 were both planned at 50; the first took its 50, the second found 10, and the Converter received 50 on one input and 10 on the other, which is not a run of its recipe at any rate. The plan now counts what each Gate takes, in their order: 30 and 30, and the Converter runs at 0.6. For the same reason a loop that returns into a full Pool through the second of two such Gates now runs; it stood still, or ran, depending on the internal order of the two Gates. A group with a single Gate is planned exactly as before, and none of the bundled examples changes. One related case is known and still open: a node outside such a group can take what one of its Gates was planned to pull. A Monte Carlo result saved before this change is shown as stale until it is run again (engine revision 10).
